final: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM matched), mix_avg AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM matched GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT AVG(m.instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(m.instownpct / x.avg_ownership) AS avg_ratio_to_mix, AVG(m.instownpct - o.avg_ownership) AS avg_excess_overall FROM matched AS m JOIN mix_avg AS x ON m.ordertypedist = x.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership
